claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchMain.PlayAfterMatchBGM (0x06004925) is an instance parameterless Void method with exact signature blob 200001 and an exact 390-byte body. It first requires bgmReqTimer > 0, decrements that field by one, and continues only when the decremented value is <= 0. It loads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting and initializes a Boolean local false. When MatchSetting.BattleRoyalKind is raw 0, it checks MatchEvaluation.inst.PlResult[0].resultPosition and PlResult[4].resultPosition against raw 1 together with isSuppressWinJingle_Blue / isSuppressWinJingle_Red; the exact suppress branch writes exitTimer=900. The non-suppress path, and the nonzero BattleRoyalKind path, set the Boolean local true only when exitTimer < 512 and MatchSetting.GameSpeed == 100. If that local remains false the method returns. Otherwise ThemeMusic raw -1 calls Menu_SoundManager.Change_BGM_Theme(String,Boolean,Boolean) with literal "BGIN_001", true, true. ThemeMusic raw -2 checks canonical MyMusic.Check_File(ThemeMusicFilename): false calls canonical Change_BGM_Theme(0,true,true) then canonical MyMusic.Set(33,String.Empty); true calls Menu_SoundManager.StopBGM(), canonical MyMusic.Set(33,ThemeMusicFilename), then Menu_SoundManager.Play_BGM(33,1). For all other ThemeMusic values, values below raw 10000 call canonical Change_BGM_Theme(ThemeMusic,true,true), while values at or above 10000 call canonical Change_BGM_Theme(0,true,true) followed by canonical MyMusic.Set(33,String.Empty).
